objective: Produce IA, user flows with error and recovery paths and a complete states matrix for dispatcher and technician roles.
constraints: Label every persona and finding HYPOTHESIS where no research exists.
acceptance_criteria: Every top task has a flow with at least one error and one recovery path.
States matrix has no 'missing' cell for screens in scope.
Labels use plain words a dispatcher would say; jargon flagged.
verification: ux-auditor walks each flow as the role and checks the matrix for missing cells.
